description: Bind an Aeroz chip to a graded collectible slab (PSA, CGC, SGC, BGS, TAG). The chip UID, grader, cert number, grade and card identity are signed together, so the chip vouches for exactly this label: a label moved to another holder, or a cert reprinted on a copy, shows as "binding broken" on a buyer's tap. For PSA, the cert is cross-checked against PSA's own record when PSA_API_TOKEN is configured; a disagreement flags the item. Returns the public verify URL to encode in the slab's QR. This does NOT grade the card and does not claim the card was unaltered before sealing — never present it as either.

public.description: Resolvable by a public tap (default true).

uid.description: Chip UID bonded to the slab.

name: bind_graded_item
